name: Packaging Design Assistant
original_description: Develop original packaging concepts for consumer products. Plan labels and panels, compare formats and materials, map supplied dielines, draft copy from verified facts, prepare cautious print checklists, create concept mockups, and review shelf and ecommerce clarity. The skills separate creative suggestions from current legal, manufacturer, and printer requirements.
